name: Cognex (CGNX)
teaser: Watchlist for new money. Cognex is a high-quality machine vision leader in a strong recovery, but the shares trade about 26% above the Base value. Industrial cyclicality and the unproven RealSense acquisition call for a 35% margin of safety, which puts the buy zone at $29.84 or below.
llms: Industrial machine vision leader in a strong cyclical recovery, acquiring RealSense for robotic perception, valued on normalized EV to EBITDA and free cash flow after stock compensation; the price implies Bull-case EBITDA. Bear $35.03, Base $45.90, Bull $65.76. Verdict HOLD at $57.70 (watchlist for new money), maximum buy price $29.84.
